title: Generated TABLESTYLE and CELLSTYLEMAP handle-role checks

source_evidence.authority: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
source_evidence.claim: Content Format text-style and border linetype references use hard-pointer handle roles.

implementation.behavior: Transactional handle reads preserve existing cursor and output state on failure; TABLESTYLE/CELLSTYLEMAP text-style and border-linetype fields require DwgHardPointer or a canonical null reference.
covered_paths: AC1021 CELLSTYLEMAP detached handle stream parsing
AC1021 legacy TABLESTYLE row-style text-style handle stream parsing
AC1024 TABLESTYLE detached handle stream parsing
AC1027 TABLESTYLE detached handle stream parsing
AC1032 TABLESTYLE detached handle stream parsing

assertions: each wrong-role mutation rejects atomically and clears prior typed state
corrected input succeeds on the same parser object

limitations: Generated controls validate the implemented role checks only; they do not establish producer prevalence or independent wire interpretation.
The receipt does not establish dependency closure, DXF output support, native rendering, or TABLE semantic support.
Other TABLESTYLE/CELLSTYLEMAP payload, flags, producer profiles, and consumer behavior remain open.
